Write her a bill of divorcement

The divorcer who remarried her off may not take her back
No remarrying your divorced wife after her second marriage; the anti-wife-recycling rule, the strangest page of the marriage manual.

Seduction obliges dowry and (at the father's option) marriage; survives as statutory Seduction Damages payable to the father — the tort feminists tried hardest to kill.
The rapist of an unbetrothed virgin pays fifty shekels and marries her, no divorce ever
The marry-your-rapist statute; stricken from every printed code, present in the canon the Constitution declares supreme — the contradiction abolitionist lawyers detonate in court.
The slandered bride's parents produce the tokens
Evidence of virginity against a defaming husband; the Tokens Procedure survives as forensic affidavits, mercifully.
The defaming husband is chastised and fined 100 shekels
He may never divorce her; defamation-of-bride damages, the no-divorce rider enforced.
If the charge is true, she is stoned at her father's door
The bride without tokens dies; on the books, unprintable, the second entry in the abolitionists' file.
Both adulterers are put to death
Capital in statute, commuted to Dissolution with Prejudice — 'except in election years.'
The betrothed pair taken in the city both die
She 'cried not' in the city; the audibility test for consent — stricken from enforcement, taught in seminaries as 'context.'
In the field, only the man dies
Where no one could hear, she is presumed innocent; the one rape statute the regime cites as humane, correctly and selectively.
The bitter-water trial of the suspected wife; revived as 'voluntary marital integrity screening,' see exo-020-014.

Do not lie with your neighbor's wife

The refusal rite: the sandal loosed (chalitzah)

The wife who seizes the assailant's secrets: cut off her hand
The only mutilation penalty in the Torah; unprintable, unrepealed — the Equivalence Tables cite its existence and decline its example.
Do not intermarry with the seven nations
No marriage with the Canaanite nations; revived as Covenant Endogamy — marriage licenses require communicant status of both parties, the conversion industry thanks you.
The Ammonite and Moabite shall not enter the congregation
Excluded to the tenth generation; Ruth the Moabitess is King David's great-grandmother — the exhibit-A the citizenship bar cites and the DFO cannot answer.
Do not abhor the Edomite or Egyptian
Their third generation may enter; the mercy clause of the exclusion code, 'pending genealogical rulemaking.'
The beautiful captive: the month of mourning before marriage
The war-bride procedure — head shaved, a month's mourning, then marriage; classified with the rest of Title XII, cited in one leaked JAG memo, then very classified.
Do not sell the captive wife
If displeased, release her free; the humane clause inside the inhumane institution — the Torah in miniature, say the seminarians who whisper.
The firstborn's double portion stands despite the hated wife
Inheritance ignores favoritism; the Double Portion rule in probate — primogeniture returned to America via Deuteronomy.
Daughters inherit when there is no son
Zelophehad's daughters' victory; the inheritance cascade, daughters-then-brothers-then-uncles, is the probate code verbatim.
Heiress daughters marry within the tribe
Land-holding daughters marry within the tribe; adapted as trust-law restrictions on heiress marriages — old money's favorite verse.
Do not deny the firstborn his right
No transferring the birthright by preference; Esau litigation is a genre.
Keep the daughters' vow law (father may annul)

Keep the wives' vow law (husband may annul)
A husband may void his wife's vows; spousal-consent requirements on women's contracts — struck down, restored, struck down, restored.
The widow's and divorcee's vows stand
No man annuls for her; the one full contractual capacity women hold by statute, and the reason remarriage rates confound the DFO's models.
